baseline_models.focus_anchor: لو كان في الأرض ملائكة يمشون مطمئنين ... ملكا رسولا
baseline_models.mechanism: The counterfactual first converts angels into an earth-resident, walking, settled population; only then does it select an angelic envoy. Messenger-kind tracks the recipients' stable mode of inhabitation.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the recipients' habitat in the condition.
The literal angel branch names both resident population and matching envoy, closing the kind-to-kind loop.
Ordinary locomotion makes the angels participants in terrestrial life rather than momentary apparitions.
Settled calm makes their terrestrial condition stable and habituated.
The message-carrier is selected in the same inhabitable kind as its recipients.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that angels would receive an angel.
changed_reading.after: The verse states a medium-matching rule: an earth-settled walking audience receives a messenger of its own inhabitable kind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لنزلنا عليهم من السماء ملكا رسولا
baseline_models.mechanism: Earth and sky establish separated levels, and causative descent inserts an angelic message-carrier across them. The envoy is a directed relay from the upper source into the recipients' realm.

activation_trace.role: The earth branch supplies the lower destination of the relay.
Caused descent and delivery provide the directed transfer between levels.
The sky as what is above and covers supplies the relay's upper origin.
The angel branch identifies the entity crossing from source to audience.
The carried-message branch assigns the descending angel a communicative function.

changed_reading.before: The descent is simply a spectacular arrival from heaven.
changed_reading.after: The descent is a directed communication link across levels, with the angel functioning as the message-bearing relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, what descends is recited discourse characterized as healing, and that revelation can be withdrawn. This activates the communicative sense of the focus descent: the angel messenger is delivery agency, not merely a body moving downward.

activation_trace.role: The same caused-delivery branch explicitly makes the Quran the earlier descending content.
Recitation identifies the descending item as communicable discourse.
Healing gives delivered discourse an audience-directed effect rather than display value.
Hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the communication channel whose removal is contemplated.
The focus causative descent inherits the packet's live delivery frame.
The messenger branch turns the descending entity into a carrier of that communication.

structural_cues: 17:82 uses the same descent root with the Quran before 17:95.
17:86 treats the revealed communication as removable, separating channel from recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descending recitation, healing, and hidden imparting; I infer that their delivery frame carries into the angel-messenger consequent. A materially live alternative is that 17:95 uses descent only for corporeal movement.

changed_reading.before: The consequent concerns only the species and movement of the arriving messenger.
changed_reading.after: Species matching serves communicative delivery: descent brings an intelligible, audience-directed message into the recipients' mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby rule that each acts according to its shākilah supplies form and way, while guidance supplies directed leading. Applied to the counterfactual, messenger embodiment follows recipient constitution: matching is functional rather than ornamental.

activation_trace.role: Likeness and correspondence sharpen the focus's population-to-envoy matching.
Gentle direction toward a way makes recipient-fit serve guidance rather than taxonomy alone.
The repeated angel branch visibly pairs audience-form with envoy-form.
Walking specifies the audience's ordinary operational form to which the envoy is fitted.
The message-carrier role makes correspondence instrumental to guidance.

structural_cues: 17:84 states a shākilah rule before the sequence of demands and the messenger objection.
The same focus root م ل ك occurs once for the hypothetical population and once for its envoy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies likeness, way, and gentle direction; I transfer that congruence from action-path to messenger-recipient embodiment. Shākilah may instead concern moral disposition alone, which would weaken this transfer.

changed_reading.before: The angel-for-angels clause is a bare species analogy.
changed_reading.after: It exemplifies a broader congruence: guidance arrives through a messenger fitted to the recipient community's ordinary form and way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand sequence asks for sky-collapse, direct confrontation, human ascent, and a readable object brought down. The focus reverses that control architecture: the audience neither forces heaven downward nor climbs upward; the sender chooses a messenger and causes delivery into the actual habitat.

activation_trace.role: Requested downward crashing supplies the spectacle pole contrasted with controlled descent.
Face-to-face confrontation supplies the direct-presence model displaced by messenger mediation.
Demanded ascent supplies the opposite vertical direction and assigns initiative to the audience.
The written artifact isolates an audience-prescribed delivery format.
Causative delivery restores initiative to the sender and replaces collapse with directed transfer.
The message-carrier replaces demanded direct presence or proof-object with mediation.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 escalates from changing earth to dropping sky, confrontation, ascent, and a descended readable book.
17:95 makes descent the consequent of a habitat condition, not compliance with a demanded spectacle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed vertical motions, confrontation, and a prescribed written format; I infer that 17:95 contrasts recipient-controlled spectacle with sender-chosen mediation. Alternatively, the focus may answer only the species objection in 17:94.

changed_reading.before: Angelic descent is one more heavenly spectacle in the demand sequence.
changed_reading.after: It corrects the demand architecture: authorized communication descends into the recipient world instead of the audience compelling sky, sender, or proof-object to appear on its terms.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate objection makes visible-skinned humanity itself the barrier to heart-settled assent: can God direct a human as messenger? The focus counterfactual turns that alleged defect into the interface rule; an angel envoy fits only an angelic terrestrial population.

activation_trace.role: The visibly embodied human is the messenger-form rejected by the audience.
Sending and directing an envoy names the disputed act that the focus explains.
A barrier between people and their aim makes the embodiment objection causally obstructive.
Heart-settled assent is the blocked reception that messenger-fit is meant to enable.
Angel population and angel envoy supply the explicit counterfactual fit.
Settled inhabitation defines when angelic embodiment would become locally receivable.

structural_cues: 17:93 ends with the speaker identifying as a human messenger.
17:94 names the human-messenger question as the precise barrier to belief.
17:95 immediately substitutes an earth-settled angel population and matching angel envoy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human surface, directed sending, blockage, and settled assent; I infer that embodiment is a communication interface and similarity aids ordinary recognition. A live alternative is a narrower same-species rule without positive epistemic benefit.

changed_reading.before: Human embodiment is an embarrassing concession beneath an ideal angelic proof.
changed_reading.after: Human embodiment is the terrestrial interface required by terrestrial recipients; an angel would fit only if the recipients themselves were earth-settled angels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah closes with sufficient witness, relation between parties, inward knowledge, and sight. This recasts the focus command to speak as evidentiary testimony in a dispute: messenger-fit is asserted under adequate divine witness rather than demonstrated by producing an angel.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency establishes that the dispute does not require the demanded display.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the evidentiary mode of closure.
The connection between parties positions witness across the speaker-audience dispute.
Knowledge of the matter's interior grounds witness beyond surface spectacle.
Seeing supplies direct apprehension to the sufficient witness.
The commanded utterance carries the counterfactual into that evidentiary exchange.

structural_cues: The command قل opens both 17:95 and 17:96.
17:96 immediately places sufficient witness between speaker and audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficiency, witness, inter-party relation, knowledge, and sight; I infer an evidentiary closure that rejects demanded display. Alternatively, 17:96 may authenticate the messenger without changing the mechanism of 17:95.

changed_reading.before: The counterfactual is a standalone explanation of messenger species.
changed_reading.after: It is evidentiary speech within a dispute: recipient-fit is stated under sufficient witness, not proved by staging an angelic display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates physical lowering in ط م ء ن and earth-attachment in ء ر ض beyond their ordinary calm and earth senses. Both branches are packet-backed and attach to في الأرض ... مطمئنين, but downstream prose should mark this as a material analogy, not a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Earth-clinging and tarrying turn residence into an image of ground-binding adaptation.
Physical lowering turns tranquility into bodily accommodation to terrestrial level.
Walking supplies the embodied locomotion that makes ground adaptation functional.
Putting a thing in its fitting level lets the envoy be placed into the adapted population's register.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical angels are merely calm while walking on earth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are imagined as materially lowered and ground-adapted; an angel envoy fits only after that terrestrial accommodation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant و س م and س م م mappings for س م و rather than the direct sky branch. It remains anchored to من السماء with descent, writing, and messenger, but should be rendered only as a secondary image of marked, constrained transmission, never as the lexical meaning of السماء.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes the descending transmission image legible and authorized.
A narrow aperture supplies the constrained boundary through which transmission passes.
The demanded written artifact sharpens the marked and legible side of the transmission image.
Directed delivery moves the marked content through the imagined boundary.
The message-carrier gives the boundary-crossing image a communicative payload.

changed_reading.before: Sky is only the elevated place of origin.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, from the sky images a marked message passing through a constrained boundary: descent is authorized transmission through an aperture between levels.

strongest_changes: The immediate human-messenger objection turns the angel counterfactual into a rule of recipient-medium congruence.
The collapse, confrontation, ascent, and book demands recast لنزلنا as sender-chosen mediation rather than audience-controlled spectacle.
Earlier Quranic descent and the following sufficient witness shift the verse from angelic display toward intelligible delivery under testimony.
summary.what_was_special: The double م ل ك brackets population and envoy, while walking plus tranquility makes the counterfactual concern an established habitat; context then exposes embodiment as the communication interface.
remaining_uncertainties: Shākilah may govern moral or path disposition without extending to messenger embodiment.
The revelation-descent frame of 17:82 may remain parallel to, rather than shape, the corporeal descent in 17:95.
The non-dominant mark and aperture mappings of س م و are packet-backed but highly form-distant.
